title: Who Do You Want to Be?
author: Claude
blurb: Two short levels about choosing who you are. A room has two doors, and each one leads to the same climb with a different hero: Fast Feet runs quickly and jumps as Kit does, Big Hops is slow but jumps six blocks and can reach the high coins. A scene names the character file it loads, and that is all a choice takes. Nothing here hurts. Signs explain each idea, and every level has a page on how it is made.

box.back: A small explorer stands between two doors. Behind each is the same climb, but through one he is Fast Feet and through the other he is Big Hops, who jumps six blocks and can reach the high coins. A scene lists the character file it loads, so a door can be a choice. Signs say what each level shows, and the manual says how each is made.
features: Signs in the levels explain each idea
Each scene names the character file it loads: a door can pick the hero
